description: This source file contains the implementation of the DefaultGrainActivator class, which is responsible for creating and disposing instances of grain classes in the Orleans runtime. It implements the IGrainActivator interface and manages the instantiation logic, including dependency injection and exception handling.

classes.name: DefaultGrainActivator
classes.description: Implements IGrainActivator to create and dispose grain instances using dependency injection.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the activator with service provider and grain class, setting up factory functions.
